name: marketing-journey-framework
description: Explore and visualize marketing strategy through 18 connected atomic units and customer journeys.

interface.shortDescription: Map marketing strategy across 18 connected units.
interface.longDescription: Research a company or business idea, explore possibilities across the 18 Atomic Units of Marketing, test their coherence, and create three customer marketing journeys through an interactive strategy map.

Map my business idea across the 18 Atomic Units.
Audit my marketing strategy and identify weak hypotheses.
